reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: accrue_interest has 7+ non-test callers (Gate 1); no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json so Gate 2 cannot trigger; contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/market.move is explicitly in-scope (Gate 3). An attacker can trigger this via any repay transaction by calling the public repay entry point, causing accrue_interest to pass asset.repay_fee_rate() (calibrated at 1bp as a flat fee) as the reserve_factor argument to reserve.accrue_interest(), resulting in zero repay fees ever being collected (protocol revenue loss) and a severely underfunded reserve (1bp instead of a meaningful reserve factor). Severity is High: deterministic protocol-wide revenue loss and reserve miscalibration on every repayment, though no direct loss of user principal funds.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/asset.move:21-22 (repay_fee_rate documented as 'fee rate paid to the protocol in repay'); contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/market.move:1025 (passed as reserve_factor to reserve.accrue_interest)
